description: This file defines the RecipeRepository class, which provides an interface to access and manipulate recipes and notes in a database, asynchronously using coroutines.

classes.name: RecipeRepository
classes.description: A repository class managing access to recipes and notes, providing suspend functions for asynchronous database operations.

methods.name: getRecipes
methods.description: Retrieves a list of all recipes.

methods.name: getCategories
methods.description: Returns a sorted list of distinct recipe categories.

methods.name: getByCategory
methods.description: Fetches recipes belonging to a specific category.

methods.name: getRecipeDetail
methods.description: Fetches detailed information for a specific recipe by ID.

methods.name: addRecipe
methods.description: Inserts a new recipe into the database and returns its ID.

methods.name: updateRecipe
methods.description: Updates the details of an existing recipe.

methods.name: setFavorite
methods.description: Marks a recipe as favorite or not.

methods.name: search
methods.description: Searches recipes by a query string.

methods.name: getNotesForRecipe
methods.description: Fetches notes associated with a specific recipe.

methods.name: addNote
methods.description: Adds a new note to a recipe.
